question: Can exact 64-pair restart checkpoints support an opt-in selected-stream vector decode diagnostic without changing the default route?
paper: Paired runtime tANS reverse-reader checkpointing proof

code.fingerprint_policy: diff_sha256 is the earlier CPU/MSL-only prototype snapshot and predates this SPI bridge; refresh the source fingerprint against the exact root-controlled candidate before runtime compilation or dispatch. No GPU command was run in this phase.

parameters.checkpoint_fields: 10-bit tANS state and 14-bit unread meaningful bit position
parameters.supported_modes: 64..95 only; fallback modes retain the production route
parameters.execution_scope: one selected packet-0 stream from source 0 in the full seven-source resident; exact comparison against 512 original indexed-HDF5 counts; no default-path changes
parameters.output: exact UInt16 values in selected-stream order; every returned count must equal the original-HDF5 count
parameters.fallback_policy: try at most eight residual packet-0 candidates; skip only explicitly reported fallback/unsupported modes; fail on any capture, segment, or parity error
parameters.timing_stages: whole diagnostic call, runtime compile, mode inspection, separate checkpoint capture pass, and four-way segment decode; original-HDF5 parity timing excluded
parameters.performance_acceptance: none; this only tests exact decode correctness for one stream and includes an extra serial capture pass
parameters.memory_acceptance: remain below the existing seven-resident allocation ceiling; report explicit diagnostic buffers and before/after Metal allocation

execution.timing_boundary: full seven-source resident load; one selected stream; diagnostic includes MSL compilation, mode inspection, serial checkpoint capture, and parallel four-way decode; original indexed-HDF5 parity reads excluded
